name: autofilename
description: File and folder path completion for VS Code, including aliases, JSON files, and configurable web-root paths.

autofilename.languages.include.description: VS Code language IDs where AutoFilename is enabled. Use '*' to enable all languages.

autofilename.languages.exclude.description: VS Code language IDs where AutoFilename is disabled. Exclusions override inclusions.

autofilename.extensions.trim.description: File extensions to omit from completion labels.

autofilename.files.include.description: File-name glob patterns eligible for completion. '*' means all files.

autofilename.files.exclude.description: File-name glob patterns excluded from completion. Exclusions override inclusions.

autofilename.webRoot.description: Workspace-relative directory used as the root for paths that start with '/'. Example: 'public'.

autofilename.suggestOnQuote.description: Automatically request path suggestions immediately after typing a quote. Disabled by default to avoid filesystem work for ordinary strings; '/' and '\\' still trigger suggestions.

autofilename.showHiddenFiles.description: Include dotfiles and dot-directories in completion results.

autofilename.foldersFirst.description: Sort folders before files in completion results.

autofilename.insertTrailingSlash.description: Insert a trailing slash after folder completions.

autofilename.continueAfterFolder.description: Automatically trigger another suggestion after inserting a folder.

autofilename.mappings.description: Map typed prefixes to workspace-relative paths or ${workspaceFolder} paths.

autofilename.autoSlashAfterDirectory.description: Insert a trailing slash after choosing a directory.

autofilename.autoTriggerNextSuggestion.description: Trigger another completion after inserting a directory slash.

autofilename.respectFilesExclude.description: Hide files and folders excluded by VS Code files.exclude settings.

scripts.compile: npm run compile:desktop && npm run compile:web
scripts.check:web: npm run compile:web && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const f='dist/web/extension.js';const text=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!text.includes('activate')||text.includes('node:fs'))process.exit(1)"
